name: QUESTDB_ClosedShell_Vertical_Clean
source: data/external/QUESTDB (MAIN + BIO + CHROM, FL excited-state geometries excluded)

ood_large_chrom.description: Train ONLY on small/medium MAIN molecules (n_heavy <= 8); test blind on large CHROM + BIO chromophores.

ood_double_polyenes_dienes.description: Hold out entire polyene/diene/cyclic-antiaromatic family (Butadiene, Hexatriene, Octatetraene, Cyclobutadiene, Pentalene, Indacene, Borole, etc.).

ood_double_azines_heterocycles.description: Hold out entire azine/quinone/dicarbonyl/nitroso family (Tetrazine, Pyrazine, Benzoquinone, Glyoxal, Nitrosomethane, Heptazine, Cyclazine, etc.). Must also exclude all HEPTA-INVEST molecules from train.

ood_invest_zero_shot.description: Train WITHOUT Heptazine / INVEST cores AND their same-InChIKey-14 conformer groups (Pentalene, Indacene_C2h) or any HEPTA-INVEST molecule; test zero-shot.
